title: Lecture 2 — basic immutable programming
summary: Understand evaluation, immutable values, and functions before moving on to input and output.
body:
The published lecture plan places **Basic Immutable Programming** in Module 1, Island of Essentials. This is an independently written study companion to the listed topic, not a transcript; no Lecture 2 slides were available in the public lecture table when checked.

Work through the explanation below, then return to the [course lecture page](https://canvas.kth.se/courses/65461/pages/lectures) and [ProgGame](https://proggame.eecs.kth.se/) for the assigned work. The examples here are separate practice, not solutions to game tasks.
